dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: My instincts say that this is a safe spot. Not the slightest whiff of lies or conspiracies.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Although to be honest, I wouldn't be averse to a little more atmosphere here — lightning flashing outside the windows, or a blizzard howling away... We could turn the lights off and tell some ghost stories.

dialogues.speaker: Shikanoin Heizou
dialogues.text: Oh well, we don't always get what we want in life. So instead — pull up a chair, and let's get some rest.
